text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan and I are having a meeting when…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yikes… My nails have gotten way too long. There's so much natural nail showing.
choice_data_list: You're not going to get them done again?
You're not going to get them done again?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: In what free time? All I do is race, race, race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I keep on top of my toenails, but… my fingernails? Well, I guess like this is better than nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For someone who's always so particular about her nails, this is a rare sight. She must really be fatigued. It might be a good idea to take another look at her race schedule.
